cases.name: core_hiphop_8s
cases.prompt: A person performs an energetic hip hop dance with deep knee bends, alternating side steps, quick torso twists and broad rhythmic arm swings.

cases.name: core_martial_combo_8s
cases.prompt: A martial artist performs a sharp combination: a left jab, a right cross, a front kick, then resets into a low guarded stance and repeats the combination.

cases.name: core_stumble_recover_8s
cases.prompt: A person walks forward, trips and stumbles, throws both arms out to regain balance, takes several quick recovery steps, and returns to a stable standing position.

cases.name: core_celebration_jump_8s
cases.prompt: A person celebrates excitedly, crouches and jumps off both feet with arms raised overhead, lands with bent knees, then pumps both fists in the air.
